host_demand.envelope_scope: Union of8 accepted native solid-signature states, not a continuous swept envelope or provider clearance.7kg unlocated power/control allowance and external service/inspection volumes require accommodation.
host_demand.host_power_scope: Pulse recharge and balancing only; feeder/lift/standby/charger thermal services are additional, not zero.
host_demand.pointing_requirement: No real customer accuracy requirement or provider attitude authority supplied; sensitivity table is the numerical demand for selected offsets/inertias.
host_demand.disposal_requirement: Host-provided disposal must remain available with zero payload releases.
host_demand.source_classification: Accepted same-revision model plus explicitly declared charger/inertia/offset assumptions; no provider approval.

installed_comparison.conclusion: At the accepted device proxies, no propellant-only crossover is possible inside the common 20kg reserve. No full installed-system commercial winner follows.
installed_comparison.mounted_vs_free_flying: Any added autonomous bus mass must be offset by omitted host accommodation/service burden plus fuel savings. At these proxies, even eliminating the entire common20kg fuel allocation leaves64.56kg penalty before an autonomous bus. Real bus/host prices, reliability, power/thermal accommodation and interfaces are unknown.
